options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: available_memory_mb
options.description: The amount of memory in MB available for a function.

options.name: description
options.description: User-provided description of a function.

options.name: entry_point
options.description: The name of the function (as defined in source code) that will be executed. Defaults to the resource name suffix, if not specified. For backward compatibility, if function with given name is not found, then the system will try to use function named "function". For Node.js this is name of a function exported by the module specified in source_location.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: environment_variables
options.description: Environment variables that shall be available during function execution.

options.name: event_trigger
options.description: An HTTPS endpoint type of source that can be triggered via URL.

options.name: https_trigger
options.description: An HTTPS endpoint type of source that can be triggered via URL.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key/value label pairs associated with this Cloud Function.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of this cloud function.

options.name: name
options.description: A user-defined name of the function. Function names must be unique globally and match pattern `projects/*/locations/*/functions/*`.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: runtime
options.description: The runtime in which to run the function. Required when deploying a new function, optional when updating an existing function.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: source_archive_url
options.description: The Google Cloud Storage URL, starting with gs://, pointing to the zip archive which contains the function.

options.name: source_repository
options.description: The source repository where a function is hosted.

options.name: source_upload_url
options.description: The Google Cloud Storage signed URL used for source uploading.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: timeout
options.description: The function execution timeout. Execution is considered failed and can be terminated if the function is not completed at the end of the timeout period. Defaults to 60 seconds.

options.name: trigger_http
options.description: Use HTTP to trigger this function.
